title: Ingestion Event Schema
description: Entry point for all camera events. Ingestion service generates trace_id and passes to Recognition.

trace_id.description: Unique event trace ID (HIAS-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXXXX-seq). Generated by ingestion service.

camera_id.description: Unique identifier for the camera/zone (e.g., GATE-MAIN, GATE-BACK)

image_data.description: Raw image metadata (base64 or S3 reference)

url.description: S3 or local file path reference (optional)

sequence_num.description: Event sequence number from camera stream
